title: Copy, Predict, Code the Rest: Lossless Graph Compression with Decoder-Side Neighbor Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2605.21510v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We present a lossless compressor for directed graphs. It copies neighbors from an earlier row, predicts further targets from the part of the graph already decoded, and codes what remains. Its main coder, the candidate-bit coder (CB), proposes a bounded set of candidate targets, mixes their probabilities adaptively, and codes the leftover targets with a popularity-aware model. The encoder tries a fixed set of vertex orders and storage directions and keeps the smallest file that decodes exactly.   On the benchmark graphs outside our development set, the selected files are smaller than the best recorded WebGraph and Zuckerli files and the best published HyperFast results. These savings have a cost. CB decodes much more slowly than the baselines and supports only sequential access. A faster companion coder, CG, is still slower than the baselines on large graphs. translated_title: 复制、预测、编码其余部分：基于解码端邻居预测的无损图压缩
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一种针对有向图的无损压缩器。它从较早的行复制邻居，从图已解码的部分预测更多目标，并对剩余部分进行编码。其主要编码器——候选位编码器（CB）——提出一个有界的候选目标集合，自适应地混合它们的概率，并使用一个考虑流行度的模型对剩余目标进行编码。编码器尝试固定的顶点排序和存储方向集合，并保留能够精确解码的最小文件。在开发集之外的基准图上，所选文件比记录在案的最好的WebGraph和Zuckerli文件以及已发表的最好的HyperFast结果都要小。这些节省是有代价的：CB的解码速度远慢于基线方法，且仅支持顺序访问。一个更快的伴随编码器CG在大图上仍然比基线慢。一个带索引的变体CS-RA提供了比测量……（可检索）文件更小的可检索文件。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种利用解码端邻居预测（复制已有邻居、预测剩余目标并对余下部分编码）的有向图无损压缩器，在基准图上实现了比WebGraph、Zuckerli和HyperFast更小的压缩文件，但代价是解码速度显著变慢。
en_tdlr: A lossless compressor for directed graphs that copies, predicts, and codes remaining neighbors from the decoded portion of the graph achieves smaller compressed files than WebGraph, Zuckerli, and HyperFast, at the cost of much slower decoding.
